chunks: And Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the right of the woman over her husband. He said:
"He should satisfy her hunger, clothe her body, and if she acts ignorantly, he should forgive her."

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman, meaning the wife in this context
key_terms.جَهِلَتْ: she acted ignorantly or behaved unwisely
key_terms.جُثَّتَهَا: her body, meaning her bodily covering through clothing
key_terms.حَقِّ: a due right or entitlement owed in the marital relationship
key_terms.زَوْجِهَا: her husband, the one responsible for these rights
key_terms.يُشْبِعُ: he satisfies or provides enough food

ai.seo_question: What are a wife's rights over her husband in this hadith from Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that among a wife's rights over her husband are maintenance through food and clothing, along with forbearance in conduct. It highlights both material support and moral patience as part of proper marital responsibility.
